sql: SELECT 'payment' kind,COUNT(*) n,COUNT(DISTINCT payment_id) ids,COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) customers FROM payment UNION ALL SELECT 'rental',COUNT(*),COUNT(DISTINCT rental_id),COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM rental

WITH first_dates AS(SELECT customer_id,MIN(payment_date) dt FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id),ties AS(SELECT p.customer_id,COUNT(*) n,COUNT(DISTINCT f.rating) ratings FROM payment p JOIN first_dates d ON p.customer_id=d.customer_id AND p.payment_date=d.dt LEFT JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id=r.rental_id LEFT JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id=i.inventory_id LEFT JOIN film f ON i.film_id=f.film_id GROUP BY p.customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) customers,SUM(n>1) ties,SUM(ratings>1) conflicting_ratings,MAX(n) largest_tie FROM ties

WITH rc AS (SELECT customer_id,COUNT(*) rentals FROM rental GROUP BY customer_id),pc AS(SELECT customer_id,COUNT(*) payments,COUNT(DISTINCT rental_id) paid_rentals,SUM(amount) spend FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) customers,SUM(payments!=rentals) unequal_event_counts,SUM(paid_rentals!=rentals) unequal_paid_rentals,MIN(rentals),MAX(rentals) FROM rc JOIN pc USING(customer_id)

WITH totals AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT customer_id,SUM(amount) total_spent FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id),rentals AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT customer_id,COUNT(DISTINCT rental_id)-1 subsequent_rentals FROM rental GROUP BY customer_id),first_payment AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT customer_id,rental_id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_date,payment_id) seq FROM payment),first_rating AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT p.customer_id,f.rating FROM first_payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id=r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id=i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id=f.film_id WHERE p.seq=1),per_customer AS(SELECT f.customer_id,f.rating,t.total_spent,r.subsequent_rentals FROM first_rating f JOIN totals t USING(customer_id) JOIN rentals r USING(customer_id)) SELECT rating,COUNT(*) customers,AVG(total_spent) avg_total_spent,AVG(subsequent_rentals*1.0) avg_subsequent_rentals FROM per_customer GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating

WITH totals AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT customer_id,SUM(amount) total_spent FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id),rentals AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT customer_id,COUNT(DISTINCT rental_id)-1 subsequent_rentals FROM rental GROUP BY customer_id),first_payment AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT customer_id,rental_id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_date,payment_id) seq FROM payment),first_rating AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT p.customer_id,f.rating FROM first_payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id=r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id=i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id=f.film_id WHERE p.seq=1),per_customer AS(SELECT f.customer_id,f.rating,t.total_spent,r.subsequent_rentals FROM first_rating f JOIN totals t USING(customer_id) JOIN rentals r USING(customer_id)) SELECT rating,AVG(total_spent) average_total_spent,AVG(subsequent_rentals*1.0) average_subsequent_rentals FROM per_customer GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating

WITH totals AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT customer_id,SUM(amount) total_spent FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id),rentals AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT customer_id,COUNT(DISTINCT rental_id)-1 subsequent_rentals FROM rental GROUP BY customer_id),first_payment AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT customer_id,rental_id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_date,payment_id) seq FROM payment),first_rating AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT p.customer_id,f.rating FROM first_payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id=r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id=i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id=f.film_id WHERE p.seq=1),per_customer AS(SELECT f.customer_id,f.rating,t.total_spent,r.subsequent_rentals FROM first_rating f JOIN totals t USING(customer_id) JOIN rentals r USING(customer_id)) ,paid_counts AS(SELECT customer_id,COUNT(*) payments FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT rating,COUNT(*) customers,AVG(total_spent) avg_spend,AVG(subsequent_rentals*1.0) true_subsequent,AVG(payments-1.0) payments_as_rentals FROM per_customer JOIN paid_counts USING(customer_id) GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating

SELECT p.customer_id,p.rental_id,COUNT(*) payment_events,GROUP_CONCAT(p.payment_id) payment_ids,GROUP_CONCAT(p.payment_date) dates,SUM(p.amount) amounts FROM payment p GROUP BY p.customer_id,p.rental_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1 ORDER BY p.customer_id,p.rental_id

WITH fp AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(payment_date) AS mpd FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id),
fm AS (SELECT p.customer_id AS cid, f.rating AS rating FROM payment p JOIN fp ON fp.customer_id=p.customer_id AND p.payment_date=fp.mpd JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id=p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id=r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id=i.film_id),
cu AS (SELECT c.customer_id AS cid, (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payment p WHERE p.customer_id=c.customer_id) AS total_amt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental r WHERE r.customer_id=c.customer_id) AS n_rentals FROM customer c)
SELECT fm.rating AS rating, ROUND(AVG(cu.total_amt),2) AS avg_total_amount_spent, ROUND(AVG(cu.n_rentals-1),2) AS avg_subsequent_rentals FROM fm JOIN cu ON cu.cid=fm.cid GROUP BY fm.rating ORDER BY fm.rating
SELECT payment_id,customer_id,rental_id,amount,payment_date FROM payment WHERE rental_id IS NULL OR rental_id NOT IN(SELECT rental_id FROM rental) ORDER BY customer_id,payment_id
